svg.title: Thirty Days to a Measured, Bid-Ready Operation
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-first-thirty-days-execution; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to a Measured, Bid-Ready Operation; subtitle: Four weekly milestones establish demand evidence, delivery economics, and launch readiness.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are milestone end days: 7, 14, 21, and 30. A first signed deal may take one to four months. The sprint builds a qualified pipeline and costed delivery system; service starts only when an actual customer contract and ready capacity support them.; caption: Use evidence at each milestone: named accounts, measured walkthroughs, reconciled bids, and a funded mobilization plan. Scheduling, inspection logs, and billing reduce administration but do not replace paid cleaning hours.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Choose the territory and establish costed operating boundaries; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Select one dense office or outpatient cluster, research 40 named buyer accounts, obtain insurance quotations, and document applicable wage and classification rules. Build the first loaded hourly-cost worksheet and choose the startup cash envelope.; label: Days 8-14; value: Conduct walkthroughs and test task-level production assumptions; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Target three completed walkthroughs where buyers agree to participate. Record cleanable area, fixtures, access, and frequencies; perform an authorized timed pilot. Use ISSA references only as initial estimates and retain observed paid-hour evidence.; label: Days 15-21; value: Issue reconciled proposals and verify deliverable labor capacity; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Target two complete proposals supported by measured scopes. Test overtime, route travel, supplies, payment delays, and customer concentration. Confirm employee availability and separately scoped provider capability without committing unfunded payroll.; label: Days 22-30; value: Prepare mobilization and continue documented buyer follow-up; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Configure scheduling, inspection forms, invoice templates, chemical records, and site-access controls. If a contract is signed, confirm coverage and training before service. Otherwise continue the same prospect cohort into months two through four without recording proposed sales as revenue.

text.title: Thirty Days to a Measured, Bid-Ready Operation
text.tspan: Thirty Days to a Measured, Bid-Ready Operation

rect.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Choose the territory and establish costed operating boundaries; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Select one dense office or outpatient cluster, research 40 named buyer accounts, obtain insurance quotations, and document applicable wage and classification rules. Build the first loaded hourly-cost worksheet and choose the startup cash envelope.

text.title: Choose the territory and establish costed operating boundaries

rect.title: label: Days 8-14; value: Conduct walkthroughs and test task-level production assumptions; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Target three completed walkthroughs where buyers agree to participate. Record cleanable area, fixtures, access, and frequencies; perform an authorized timed pilot. Use ISSA references only as initial estimates and retain observed paid-hour evidence.

text.title: Conduct walkthroughs and test task-level production assumptions

rect.title: label: Days 15-21; value: Issue reconciled proposals and verify deliverable labor capacity; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Target two complete proposals supported by measured scopes. Test overtime, route travel, supplies, payment delays, and customer concentration. Confirm employee availability and separately scoped provider capability without committing unfunded payroll.

text.title: Issue reconciled proposals and verify deliverable labor capacity

rect.title: label: Days 22-30; value: Prepare mobilization and continue documented buyer follow-up; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Configure scheduling, inspection forms, invoice templates, chemical records, and site-access controls. If a contract is signed, confirm coverage and training before service. Otherwise continue the same prospect cohort into months two through four without recording proposed sales as revenue.

text.title: Prepare mobilization and continue documented buyer follow-up

Assumptions: Numeric values are milestone end days: 7, 14, 21, and 30. A first signed deal may take one to four months. The sprint builds a qualified pipeline and costed delivery system; service starts only when an actual customer contract and ready capacity support them.
